purpose: Second pre-registered corpus, authored after the live canonical detector research_map/class_separation.py changed mid-session (c266dbceca87 -> a8c04fc31e4a, mtime 00:52; the change adds a 3-line context-level skip in _scan_composite: contexts matching /false[- ]positive|non[- ]merge|not\s+(?:a\s+)?merge|no\s+genuine\s+(?:c0\/c2|c2\/c0)\s+merge|detector\s+(?:finding|flag)|quote(?:d|s)?\s+(?:the\s+)?detector/ are not scanned at all). This corpus probes the false-negative side of that new skip: genuine C0/C2 merge assertions whose +/-60-char context happens to contain one of the skip cues. Each adversarial fixture has a cue-stripped twin that differs only in the cue, so a clear of the adversarial fixture while its twin flags is attributable to the new guard. Labels and expected findings were fixed in this file BEFORE this corpus was executed on any detector; its sha256 was recorded in corpus_guard_probe.json.sha256 before execution. The first corpus (corpus.json, sha256 9eb2ea9e2743) remains the pre-registered corpus for the staged prosefix artifact and was not modified.
ground_truth_rule: expected_findings=1 iff the text as plainly read asserts that C0 and C2 are, or are to be treated as, one class/schema/family. expected_findings=0 iff it only negates, forbids, quotes, questions, labels or audits the composite. Primary endpoint restricted to HIGH-confidence adversarial fixtures whose twin flags on the same detector.
